newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK PRIEST ARRESTED FOR TRANSPORTING ILLEGAL IMMIGRANTS-ANA.
newsitem.headline: GREEK PRIEST ARRESTED FOR TRANSPORTING ILLEGAL IMMIGRANTS-ANA.

text.p: A Greek priest was arrested in Thessaloniki for transporting illegal Albanian immigrants from Kastoria, near the Greek-Albanian border, to Thessaloniki for 20,000 drachmas each, the state Athens News Agency (ANA) said.

Father Serafim Asimakopoulos, 59, who is a parish priest in the village of Avgh Kastoria, was caught transporting four illegal Albanians with his car, it said. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
